mapper.select: SELECT id, enabled, min_usage_daily, payout_ratio, multiplier_min, multiplier_max, max_reward, daily_budget, updated_at FROM bot_lottery_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bot_lottery_settings ( id, enabled, min_usage_daily, payout_ratio, multiplier_min, multiplier_max, max_reward, daily_budget, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, #{enabled}, #{minUsageDaily}, #{payoutRatio}, #{multiplierMin}, #{multiplierMax}, #{maxReward}, #{dailyBudget}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, min_usage_daily = EXCLUDED.min_usage_daily, payout_ratio = EXCLUDED.payout_ratio, multiplier_min = EXCLUDED.multiplier_min, multiplier_max = EXCLUDED.multiplier_max, max_reward = EXCLUDED.max_reward, daily_budget = EXCLUDED.daily_budget, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
